work_context.location_limits: Based in Antwerp, Belgium: 2 days per week in the office. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU may work remotely, with quarterly on-site weeks.
culture_signals: Values pragmatic engineering, clear documentation and a sustainable pace.
The job ad describes a runbook-driven on-call team and blameless post-mortems.
The company says teams are small and own what they run; engineers write short design notes and spend one day per sprint on reliability work.
Company values: “Be dependable. Say what you see. Leave it better.”
The company says it welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds.
